Contents Update!

Thank you all for playing RAF :) We want to let you play and enjoy any new contents we make even if those can be small and comparably unstable. We believe the quality and the quantity of RAF will be better as we go through future updates. Thank you for your continuous interest and support :)




This update contains the followings:

1. User Interface update
We have changed 3D UIs in the lobby and also 2D UIs used while you are on your tank.

2. Two Game Mode Updates
- 4vs4 mode now includes a new goal. As soon as a team reaches a certain point by destroying the enemies or score earning objects, the team will win the game.

- New solo mode! We wholeheartedly empathize with your feedbacks that our game is 'too early access', that we included a solo play mode this time. We are planning on more contents for the future of course :) 

We just want to let you play and enjoy any small but new contents we make

notes.title: Now we're ready to start!
notes.content:
[h1]We are finally ready to show you fantastic driving shooter[/h1]

Get ready to ride your cutey but fierce tank!
You are going to drive it like a real one with VR.

Looks very cute and you might feel like you are in a cartoon.
However, once you jump in this world, you will have no choice but to shoot your enemies.

This will be 8vs8 war!

We are very exited about meeting you guys
Please make sure you can join us on the 26th.
